verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a PR-review bot, for example re-running reviews or resolving findings across many PRs at once. The evidence shows no such user-invoked bulk action. Automatic per-PR reviews, the per-PR manual trigger comment, the 'All repositories' choice when installing the GitHub app, and organization-wide rules are adjacent automation and configuration scope, not bulk operations over many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
